'''Nax''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and part of the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates both the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]], which depicts the debut of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], in which Nax appears, to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Since the latter work depicts Nax as a [[clone trooper]] in the Grand Army of the Republic during the [[Battle of Teth]], he must have also appeared in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Nax served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] and later the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], where he assisted General Skywalker and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in recovering a kidnapped [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]]. He was one of the six clone troopers to survive the mission.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Nax stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nax first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
